notes: SHIP v1.14.410 - THE DESIGN SYSTEM IS LOCKED, AND FOUR PHONE SCREENS TAKE IT. Step 1 of the UI finishing sprint. PHANTOM_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md is the authoritative source and the owner carried all six rulings in its section 0 on 2026-08-07. THE AUDIT THAT PRODUCED IT, measured not assumed: 191 tokens of which 28 were never used and 13 resolved by cascade; 1116 literal padding/margin/gap declarations against 45 tokenised; 25 distinct border-radii; 36 distinct font-sizes; 135 literal z-indexes against a six-step scale that was unused for four of its steps. R-A adds one 4px spacing scale, R-B collapses 25 radii to five steps, R-C keeps the six existing type steps and starts using the top three, R-D names the hotter 3D-surface colours instead of letting --cyan silently mean two things, R-F promotes the already-inlined PhantomBrand to the display tier. R-E IS A DELIBERATE NON-ACTION: the 1116 literals are NOT mass-refactored, because that is high blast radius across a 55k-line single file for zero visible improvement; each screen takes the scale as that screen is finished, so the radius stays at one surface at a time. R-F IS THE ONE THAT CHANGES HOW THE APP LOOKS. --orb and --raj are consumed 376 times and both resolved to -apple-system, so PHANTOM's display face was Helvetica - the exact thing DESIGN_RULES section 1 bans as the clearest generic tell. Sixteen more elements declared 'Orbitron', for which this build ships NO @font-face at all, so they fell back to Helvetica too. PhantomBrand (Audiowide) is already inlined at :37 for the wordmark, so the top of the type ladder costs ZERO new bytes and carries zero offline risk. Measured at 390 it is 6 percent wider than the stack it replaces. COMMAND. Offline stopped screaming: 'API OFFLINE' was classified 'warn', which painted the loudest element on the screen gold with an accelerated heartbeat and out-shouted the actual call to action. This app is offline-first, so offline is normal and needs no human; it has its own quiet cyan state now and genuine faults keep the loud channels. The header subtitle stopped truncating to 'COREWEAVE - S...' via one min-width:0 - the text was never too long, the flex row was refusing to shrink. The ingest dropzone went from 520px to 280px and is centred in the space that is actually free, scoped to [data-master=0] so the populated Command is untouched. BUILD. THE CYAN-TO-VIOLET GRADIENT IS GONE from the primary action. It was two problems at once: DESIGN_RULES section 1 bans the violet-gradient cliche by name, and it ran BETWEEN two semantic channels - cyan means action, violet means derived intelligence - so a blend of them asserted nothing. It is replaced by the padding-box primitive, NOT the machined border-box ring, because that ring does not paint on a raw button on iOS. 'No Master loaded' stopped looking like a different product; the paragraph stays sentence case on purpose because an empty state is an invitation to act. A real bug fell out: the CTA declared no font-family and fell through to the UA default. FORGE, AND ITS PERMANENT CONTROL PLACEMENT (owner ruling). Grid and search are scene-level utilities and no longer share the rack-navigation row: they moved to a cluster in the upper right of the scene. THE CLUSTER IS A CHILD OF THE HEADER AT top:100%, so its clearance is DERIVED - the header has no height token and computes to 81px from content, and a top:81px would be exactly the constant that went stale twice before (.341 nav, .351 phase dock). Amber is retired from the grid button: gold is the attention channel and a view toggle needs no attention. The carousel now owns row 1 alone, full width between the gutters, with scroll padding and the focused rack centring itself. The rack ID moved to the 10px floor and the chip SIZES TO ITS CONTENT with a 76px floor, so no ID length can clip. ONE DEVIATION FROM THE OWNER'S LITERAL PILL LIST, stated rather than hidden: ' - FOCUS' is dropped from the id pill. Measured with the row tightened as far as it honestly goes, the three strings needed 384px in a 354px row and the walk pill ran to x=402, off the viewport. The owner's own rule settles it - operational text never drops below the floor to fit more items - so the redundant word gives, not the size; the pill already carries a lit dot and is hidden entirely unless a rack is focused. THIS WAS A LIVE DEFECT A .409 PROBE HID by injecting a shorter label than setFocus writes. The undo notice was VERIFIED, NOT REBUILT: it is already absolute above the dock, auto-dismisses at 4000ms, and UNDO stays hit-testable. TOOLS. The filter input was 40px, under the gloved floor. Tile subtitles were 9.5px, below the app's own declared 10px floor, on the line that says what each tool does. All five rules are scoped to #ref-grid deliberately: .rf-card and .rf-glabel are unscoped shared rules that also dress #work-grid and .deploy-tools-grid and .rf-card is not body.rd-gated at all, so editing them in place could have moved ?legacy=1. GUARD: test/e2e/08-forge-layout.spec.js grows to 17 tests. The derived-clearance test's old lever DIED honestly - it grew the status row by wrapping it, and the one-baseline ruling made that row nowrap, so its own vacuity guard reported that half the test proved nothing. It is replaced by a live lever, the type scale, and is now stronger: six runs, five distinct stack heights from 110 to 175.6px, clearance exactly 10px in every one. Three new tests pin the ruling itself - utilities out of the dock and drawing no amber, carousel alone in row 1 with a real overflow vacuity guard, three pills on one baseline inside the viewport. A bug in one of those new tests was found and fixed before it shipped: a bare toBeLessThanOrEqual(1) passes for every negative delta, so the centring assertion was vacuous in exactly the case it existed to catch. GATES: 3 inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, CSS braces balanced, CRLF intact with 0 lone LF, three-stamp lockstep, zero tappable targets under 44px on all four screens, horizontal overflow 0 on all four. RACK SCENE LOCK respected - nothing under #forge3d-mount, forge3d_render, drawGuts or the camera rig. DEVICE-VERIFY, folded into the open batch pass: clear the service-worker cache, confirm v1.14.410, then check the four things a harness cannot - that PhantomBrand actually renders on the iPhone rather than falling back, that the Forge utility cluster clears the notch and the header at device scale, that the bottom strip still clears the home indicator (env(safe-area-inset-bottom) is 0 here, so it is verified by NOTHING off-device), and that the quiet offline pill is still readable in cold-aisle lighting.
